Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data hallucination and logical error in the final step. It incorrectly swapped the birth dates of the two directors. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Jason Michael Brescia was born on June 19, 1986, and Oscar Barney Finn was born on October 28, 1938. However, in the final analysis, the Planner stated: "Oscar Barney Finn born 1986-06-19" and "Jason Michael Brescia born 1943-06-09". This is a complete inversion of the facts gathered in previous steps (Finn is the 1938 birth, Brescia is the 1986 birth). Consequently, the Planner concluded that Brescia was born earlier, which is factually incorrect based on the data retrieved; Oscar Barney Finn (born 1938) was born earlier than Jason Michael Brescia (born 1986). The error stems from a failure to correctly map the retrieved data to the correct entities during the synthesis phase.
